summary:
Full-stack verification of (1) the describeActiveExit precedence bug fix (coin > strategy > global) across Backend, Web and Mobile, and (2) the Phase-1 Research Lab PDF upgrade (5 new sections + Strategy column in trade log). ALL 5 backend pytest cases PASS. Web UI PASS on 3/3 scope cases (per-coin, per-strategy, global). Mobile UI PASS on 3/3 scope cases. Parity: web and mobile 'Current Active Exit' cards render identical typeLabel + scopeLabel + parameter rows for the same settings payload — confirmed live in-browser. Backend settings baseline restored at end (native / 3.0 / 2.2 / 1.6 / 0.9, empty profile_overrides + asset_exit_overrides).

Backend (5/5 PASS, /app/test_reports/pytest/iter81_results.xml):
  • test_global_only — PUT fixed_pct/4.2/1.8 with empty overrides; GET roundtrips; describeActiveExit → global · Fixed-% Stop.
  • test_per_strategy_override_wins_over_global — hunter atr_trailing override with global native; describeActiveExit → strategy · ATR Trailing Stop · Per-strategy · hunter (matches web/mobile).
  • test_per_coin_override_wins_over_strategy — BTC/USD fixed_pct override + hunter strategy override; describeActiveExit → coin · Fixed-% Stop · Per-coin · BTC/USD.
  • test_plain_profile_tuning_without_method_stays_global — profile_overrides.hunter without a `method` field is correctly ignored → stays global (guards against 'plain tuning treated as override' regression).
  • test_done_run_pdf_has_new_sections_and_strategy_column — reuses DONE backtest run 552a4cb3-b2c9-4113-83e8-59aebf741c30, downloads /api/lab/runs/{id}/pdf (application/pdf, %PDF magic), pdfminer.six extracts text; ALL 5 new sections present: 'Strategy-wise Performance Summary', 'Regime × Strategy Performance Matrix', 'Exit Type Performance per Strategy', 'Top Winning', 'Losing Setups'; 'Full trade log' section header found and 'Strategy' column header present in the trade-log window.

Web UI (3/3 PASS, /tmp/iter81_web_ok.png):
  • per-COIN → active-exit-type='Fixed-% Stop', rows show 6.6% / 2.4%, scope='Per-coin · BTC/USD'.
  • per-STRATEGY → active-exit-type='ATR Trailing Stop', rows show 2.1% / 1.2% / 3.3%, scope='Per-strategy · hunter'.
  • GLOBAL (native, no overrides) → active-exit-type='Universal Exit Engine', rows show 2x / 1.6% / 2.2%, scope='Global (all markets)'.

Mobile UI (3/3 PASS, /tmp/iter81_mobile_ok.png):
  • per-COIN → ee-active-name='Fixed-% Stop', card shows TAKE-PROFIT TARGET 6.6% / STOP-LOSS 2.4%, ee-active-scope='Scope · Per-coin · BTC/USD'.
  • per-STRATEGY → ee-active-name='ATR Trailing Stop', card shows TRAIL ARM 2.1% / TRAIL DISTANCE 1.2% / HARD STOP-LOSS 3.3%, ee-active-scope='Scope · Per-strategy · hunter'.
  • GLOBAL → ee-active-name='Universal Exit Engine', ee-active-scope='Scope · Global (all markets)'.

Parity: WEB and MOBILE agree on all 3 scope cases (same method name, same scope label, same parameter values). The mobile describeActiveExit() at workspace.tsx:55-75 is a byte-parity port of the web helper at exitConfig.js:29-66 — confirmed by inspection AND by identical rendered output in the browser for each scope case.
action_items: LOW (unchanged from iter80): /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:44-75 duplicates describeActiveExit byte-for-byte from /app/frontend/src/lib/exitConfig.js. Extract to /app/mobile/src/lib/exitConfig.ts and share, so a future edit on one side cannot re-introduce the coin/strategy/global inconsistency that this iteration proves is currently correct.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/exitConfig.js:20-26 firstExitOverride correctly filters only entries with a `method` field — plain profile-tuning payloads (e.g. {hunter: {trail_atr_mult: 2.5}}) are ignored and the card falls back to the global setting. Verified via test_plain_profile_tuning_without_method_stays_global.

/app/backend/lab/lab_report.py:54-68 _live_exit_desc — mirrors the same precedence (per-coin > per-strategy > global) inside the PDF's Run Configuration block, so the PDF, the Exit Engine home card, and the Risk Monitor card can no longer disagree.

/app/backend/lab/lab_report.py:259-380 strategy analytics helpers (_strategy_summary_flow / _regime_strategy_matrix_flow / _exit_per_strategy_flow / _top_setups_flow / _strategy_analytics_block) — pure post-hoc computation over the existing per-symbol trade_log, no backtest engine changes required, keeps regression surface minimal. Confirmed in the rendered PDF.
/app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:44-75 describeActiveExit and /app/frontend/src/lib/exitConfig.js:20-66 are byte-parity ports. Not a bug today, but a real DRY risk (see action_items).

seed_data_creation: During tests, temporarily set profile_overrides.hunter (atr_trailing 2.1/1.2/3.3) and asset_exit_overrides['BTC/USD'] (fixed_pct 6.6/2.4). Restored to native/3.0/2.2/1.6/0.9 with empty overrides at end of both backend fixture teardown and both UI scripts. Confirmed baseline restored via unauth GET.
context_for_next_testing_agent: describeActiveExit precedence (coin > strategy > global) is FIXED and VERIFIED across all three surfaces. Reusable pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_exit_and_lab_pdf.py covers (a) settings PUT/GET roundtrip for both override maps, (b) the plain-tuning-without-method regression guard, (c) the DONE lab PDF sections check. To re-run: `pytest tests/test_iter81_exit_and_lab_pdf.py -v` with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + OWNER_EMAIL + OWNER_PASSWORD in env. It reuses /tmp/rid.txt or the most-recent DONE backtest; will create a fresh one only if none exists (takes 2-3 min). Mobile testids for the active-exit card: ee-active-exit (root), ee-active-name, ee-active-scope. Web testids: active-exit-card (root), active-exit-type, plus per-row active-exit-val-<label-slug>. Bottom nav on mobile web preview shows a 'Coming Soon → Continue to Cockpit' modal on first load — dismiss it before tapping tab-workspace.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. The describeActiveExit precedence fix ships identically on web (exitConfig.js) and mobile (workspace.tsx describeActiveExit), backend /api/settings PUT/GET correctly roundtrips both profile_overrides and asset_exit_overrides, and the lab PDF renders all 5 new Phase-1 sections plus the Strategy column in the Full trade log. Only unresolved item is the DRY-mobile action item carried forward from iter80 (extract the shared helper), which is non-blocking.
